supersession.reason: Run began and was cancelled after read-only QA found measurement and runtime defects; no artifact, package, or result was published.

hypothesis: Under identical isolated-lab notice, trust, and load, Q1 reports R8 mobility, TCP reconnect, and GARP VIP movement without post-hoc tuning.

topology.network: IPv4-only isolated Linux namespaces on one host; no namespace has an outside route and no dynamic routing is permitted.
topology.links_and_addresses: Client/router is 10.88.0.2/24 and 10.88.0.1/24. Router bridge is 10.88.1.1/24. Server old and candidate interfaces are 10.88.1.2/24 and 10.88.1.3/24. VIP is 10.88.1.100/32.
topology.fixed_mac_addresses: While down assign router bridge 02:00:00:00:01:01, old server interface 02:00:00:00:01:02, and candidate server interface 02:00:00:00:01:03.
topology.routing: Client default route is via 10.88.0.1. Server main client-prefix route initially uses gateway 10.88.1.1 on old. Table 101 first has 10.88.1.0/24 dev old scope link then client prefix via gateway old for source 10.88.1.2/32. Table 102 first has 10.88.1.0/24 dev candidate scope link then client prefix via gateway candidate onlink for source 10.88.1.3/32. Table 103 first has 10.88.1.0/24 dev old scope link then client prefix via gateway old for VIP source. At common candidate activation replace the main client-prefix route via gateway candidate onlink. Table 103 is separately replaced only at GARP cutover.
setup_order: loopbacks, client link, router links and bridge, and old server link up
temporarily candidate up solely for static table 102 route installation
candidate down before pre-trial counters and clock
topology.static_neighbors: Before the clock and identically for all mechanisms and arms, router bridge permanently maps old and candidate numeric addresses to their fixed MACs; each server interface permanently maps gateway 10.88.1.1 to bridge MAC. No static VIP neighbor exists; GARP remains measured. No neighbor flush or dynamic discovery is permitted.
topology.server_strong_host_sysctls: Only in the isolated server namespace before trials, set IPv4 rp_filter=0 and arp_ignore=1, arp_announce=2 for all, default, old, and candidate interfaces.
topology.environment: All non-loopback links use MTU 1500 and fq_codel. Effective socket send and receive buffers are exactly 262144. GRO, GSO, and TSO are disabled and verified with ethtool; ethtool is a prerequisite.
topology.dns: disabled; every endpoint is numeric IPv4
topology.privileges: runner MUST start as root and retain CAP_NET_ADMIN and CAP_NET_RAW; missing privilege fails setup and never skips
topology.evidence_counts: interface_count is exactly 10 including three loopbacks; non_loopback_interface_count is exactly 7; veth_pair_count is exactly 3.

traffic.payload: exactly 64 bytes: big-endian u64 sequence followed by 56 zero bytes
traffic.rate: 100 Hz; exactly 800 due payloads at equal next-due 10 ms deadlines
traffic.schedule: Both endpoints and the R8 session are established before a private shared absolute gate; T-3 seconds through T+5 seconds use scheduled timestamps.
traffic.accounting: scheduled, attempted, full-send, and authenticated-receive are distinct; schedule misses are retained
traffic.transport: TCP_NODELAY; TCP reconnect retries on each due deadline. TCP old/new listeners are numeric address/port and SO_BINDTODEVICE-bound to corresponding server interfaces; no wildcard or weak-host listener.

blocking.global_schedule: 66 balanced consecutive blocks of 20: every pair occurs 3 or 4 times per block, exactly two pairs have four occurrences in each block, and every pair has exactly 22 four-count blocks and 220 total occurrences.
blocking.warmup_assignment: the first 20 occurrences of each mechanism-arm pair are warmups and remaining 200 are measured
blocking.randomization: deterministic per-block seeded permutation is the sole trial order

timing_and_actions.candidate_proof_timeout: 3 seconds matching challenge expiry and never extending T+5 observation
timing_and_actions.worker_supervisor: phase-aware; up to 40 seconds only for bounded teardown and error capture, never measurement. It may probe static source-policy route selection without output or traffic.
timing_and_actions.common_candidate_activation: For every arm/mechanism, immediately after candidate link-up at T-2 in make-before-break or T in abrupt-break, replace and verify server main client-prefix route via gateway candidate onlink. This is one identical explicit static underlay action, not dynamic routing.
timing_and_actions.abrupt-break: At T activate candidate and common main route, then perform the mechanism action. R8 sends one authenticated LOC_UPDATE and sole candidate proof; TCP makes new listener usable, takes old interface down, and reconnects; GARP atomically moves VIP, replaces only table 103 client prefix via candidate onlink, and runs exactly three arping -U -c 1 -w 1 operations 100 ms apart, each returning before next and accepting return 0 or 1.
timing_and_actions.make-before-break: At T-2 activate candidate and common main route without traffic cutover. At T R8 sends one authenticated LOC_UPDATE and sole proof, TCP takes old interface down and reconnects, and GARP moves VIP/table 103 then performs its three bounded announcements.

readiness_and_outage.readiness: ten temporally consecutive numeric post-T authenticated echoes, each with due <= receive < due+10 ms
readiness_and_outage.outage_start: last successfully received pre-T on-schedule payload

collection.boundaries: Record interface counters at scheduled T-3, T, and T+5 boundaries. Record worker and both endpoint CPU exactly from shared gate through T+5. Record actual activation start and complete separately from scheduled activation.
collection.identifier_redaction: Evidence records configuration and command hashes only; raw IPs, MACs, ports, argv, LOC, namespace/interface/veth names, routes, commands, stderr, and child output are prohibited.
collection.failure_classification: Only pre-gate launch/readiness failures are setup failures. Runtime and endpoint failures after the shared gate retain setup_status=complete and all available parent-owned append-only event/counter evidence. Corrupt or unavailable evidence is null and evidence_complete=false; no count is inferred. Missing or false cleanup, evidence, CPU, environment, or topology proof suppresses publication eligibility while retaining diagnostic upload.
collection.event_writer_trust: Event writers are source-bound measured implementations. Parent-owned persistent files prevent supervisor fabrication but do not defend a root-compromised endpoint, which is outside the trusted-host model.

implementation_binding.runner_semantics: Frozen against current bench/q1.py and tests/mobility_netns.py semantics; implementation source identity is the canonical sorted JSON SHA-256 map below and is independently bound to the supplied git commit.
implementation_binding.verification: Before publication regenerate from raw data, recompute source-map identity, and verify it separately against the exact supplied git commit; mismatch invalidates publication.

block_bootstrap_95_percent_ci.value_form: each field is [2.5th percentile, 97.5th percentile] or null when undefined
block_bootstrap_95_percent_ci.sampling: deterministically resample complete blocks with replacement
